_about: Settings for New York's Routes page (engine/routes/: build.py, page.html), at /nyc/routes/: pick a stop or platform near you, see where each MTA bus and subway line from it goes. The subway's lines come from raw/surface/rapid_*.json (surface.json 'rapid'), their platforms in order.

live.source: MTA Bus Time and MTA subway GTFS-Realtime

_gridTilt: Manhattan's street grid is turned about 29 degrees east of north, so the avenues read north-south and the streets east-west.
_platformLabels: Platforms are headed with the MTA's own direction words (Uptown & The Bronx, Manhattan, Coney Island), from cities/nyc/fetch_station_labels.py.
knownWithThe: ^(.* District|.* Village|Bowery|Battery|Upper East Side|Upper West Side|Lower East Side|Rockaways|Hub)$

page.title: Where does this line or route go?
page.description: Find the bus stops and subway platforms nearest you in New York City and see where each route goes, with live next-bus and next-train times: the neighborhoods it passes through, the main streets it runs along, its subway connections and the landmarks on the way.
page.lede: Find the stops and stations near you, then pick a bus or subway line to see where it goes: the neighborhoods, main streets, connections and landmarks along the way.
page.outside: That spot is outside New York City. Try an address in the five boroughs.
page.noMatch: No match in New York City for “{q}”. Try the full street name, like “350 Fifth Avenue”.
page.noStops: No stops or stations within {r} of that spot.
page.credits: Routes, stops and timetable: MTA (New York City Transit and MTA Bus) GTFS · Neighborhoods: NYC Department of City Planning · Streets: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · Live times: MTA Bus Time and MTA subway GTFS-Realtime

badges._about: Route badge colours for apps (the web page takes them from factsheet.css): buses white with an MTA blue outline, express buses green; subway lines as round bullets in the trunk line's colour.

_notCrossed: A bus crosses avenues, not the bridge decks and tunnel approaches drawn over or under them.
